name: poisonpill
description: Local-first MV3 extension that flags predatory contract clauses with a Rust/Wasm engine.

scripts.build: esbuild extension/src/content.ts extension/src/worker.ts extension/src/popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --outdir=dist --log-level=warning && esbuild extension/src/pdf-page.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --alias:pdfjs-dist=./node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs --outfile=dist/pdf-page.js --log-level=warning
